assessmentQuestionVersion.name: Premise Type
assessmentQuestionVersion.questionText: What type of premises will be used to prepare and/or store food at the site of the event? Check all that apply.
assessmentQuestionVersion.responseValues: Plumbed in hand sink available at the booth Portable sink in booth with pressurized hot and cold running water Portable sink shared between booths, easily accessible with pressurized hot and cold running water Temporary hand wash station in booth, acceptance is subject to Health review Will bring our own soap and paper towels, if not supplied by venue Hand washing sink or station not needed, food is prepackaged, no portioning or handling on site, acceptance is subject to Health review
